data_dir.description: Directory of the database. Empty: /var/lib/greenlens for the system service, $XDG_DATA_HOME/greenlens for a user.

host_root.description: Root of the host file system, such as /host in a container with the host root mounted there.

sample_interval.description: How often energy is sampled, from 50ms to 60s.

socket.description: Unix socket of the agent. Empty: /run/greenlens/greenlens.sock for the system service, $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/greenlens/greenlens.sock for a user.

idle_policy.description: How idle energy is attributed: dynamic, proportional, full or wall.

max_consumers.description: Most consumers tracked by the proxy; the others are reported together as 'other'.

max_models_per_backend.description: Most models tracked per backend; the energy of the others is reported together as 'other'.

regression_min_r2.description: Lowest R2 at which the energy per prompt token and per generated token, fitted over the last 24 hours, is reported.

backends.description: Inference servers declared in the configuration. They keep their name across restarts and take precedence over discovered ones.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the server, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000.

kind.description: Engine of the backend, which selects how its tokens are read.

name.description: Name of the backend in reports and metrics: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

process.description: File name of the executable, to find the processes of a process backend or of a server whose port is not visible.

enabled.description: Look for known inference servers among the running processes.

interval.description: How often processes and listening ports are scanned, from 1s to 10m.

emission_factor_g_per_kwh.description: Grid emission factor in gCO2e/kWh. Null: FESEN 2024, 444 gCO2e/kWh.

emission_factor_source.description: Where a configured emission factor comes from; required when the factor is set.

hourly_profile_file.description: Absolute path of a CSV file with the grid intensity of each hour of the week (weekday,hour,g_co2e_per_kwh), which replaces the emission factor hour by hour. Empty: the factor applies to every hour.

pue.description: Power usage effectiveness of the facility; 1.0 means no overhead.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the tariff.

periods.description: Time-of-use prices. price_per_kwh applies outside them; without it, the periods must cover the whole week.

days.description: Weekdays of the period: sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri or sat.

from.description: Local time the period starts, such as 18:00.

price_per_kwh.description: Price per kWh during the period, in the currency of the tariff.

to.description: Local time the period ends, later than from on the same day; 24:00 is the end of the day.

price_per_kwh.description: Price of electricity per kWh. Null: cost is not reported.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the hourly profile and the tariff periods, such as America/Mexico_City. Empty: the time zone of the system.

wue_l_per_kwh.description: Water usage effectiveness in liters per kWh. Null: water is not reported.

format.description: Format of the agent logs: json or text.

level.description: Minimum level of the agent logs: debug, info, warn or error.

consumer_aliases_file.description: YAML file mapping consumer names to the SHA-256 of header values, written as sha256:<hex>.

consumer_header.description: Request header that tells consumers apart, such as Authorization; its value is kept only as an HMAC.

listen.description: Address and port the proxy listens on.

per_request_energy_header.description: Add X-GreenLens-Energy-Joules to each response, as a trailer for streamed ones.

upstream.description: Base URL of the server the proxy forwards to.

raw.description: How long raw samples are kept.

rollup_1h.description: How long one-hour rollups are kept.

rollup_1m.description: How long one-minute rollups are kept.

enabled.description: Serve the HTTP API and the graphical interface.

listen.description: Address and port of the HTTP API. Listening beyond loopback needs at least one access token.

metrics_auth.description: Ask for an access token on /metrics too.

key_file.description: Private key in PEM, readable only by the agent.

tokens_file.description: File of access tokens, kept as argon2id hashes. Empty: tokens in the data directory.

auto.description: Choose sources automatically. When false, only the sources named in sources.force are used.

exponent.description: Exponent of the utilization in the estimate model; 1 is linear.

full_watts.description: Power of the whole CPU at 100% utilization for the estimate model; 0 uses the embedded table.

idle_watts.description: Power of the whole CPU at 0% utilization for the estimate model; 0 uses the embedded table.

force.description: Source preferred for a domain (package, dram, gpu, psys, platform), such as {package: perf_event}.

helper.description: Path of greenlens-nvml, the helper that reads NVIDIA GPUs. Empty: next to greenlens, then /usr/libexec/greenlens and /usr/lib/greenlens.

min_interval.description: Shortest sampling interval accepted; raising it lowers the time resolution of the RAPL counters.
